|game_text=Deploy on table. Whenever an opponent's alien is just lost, they lose 1 Force. While all of your ability on table is provided by Imperials and Imperial starship pilots, Emperor, your admirals, generals, and moffs are deploy -1 and are forfeit +1. Aliens are deploy +1 and forfeit -1.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Empire's New Order (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image shown here both print this text.
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on table. Whenever an opponent’s alien is just lost, they lose 1 Force. While all of your ability on table is provided by Imperials and Imperial starship pilots, Emperor, your admirals, generals, and moffs are deploy -1 and are forfeit +1. Aliens are deploy +1 and forfeit -1.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Empire's New Order (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Empire's New Order (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “Emperor, your admirals, generals, and moffs” to “your admirals, generals, moffs, and Emperor”: “Deploy on table. Whenever an opponent's alien is just lost, they lose 1 Force. While all of your ability on table is provided by Imperials and Imperial starship pilots, your admirals, generals, moffs, and Emperor are deploy -1 and are forfeit +1. Aliens are deploy +1 and forfeit -1.”.<ref name="cl-1230_28-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
